subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Digital Identity for the Undocumented
description: One-minute skill: Digital Identity for the Undocumented.

hook.text: One billion people worldwide have no official identity documents. Digital ID could include them — or exclude them.

buildup.text: Without ID, people can't access banking, healthcare, education, or government services.

discovery.text: Digital identity programs in India and Estonia have given millions their first verifiable identity.

twist.text: But digital ID also creates a tracking infrastructure. Inclusion comes with the risk of surveillance.

climax.text: Digital identity can liberate the excluded or surveil the vulnerable. The design makes all the difference.

punchline.text: Identity for all. Or surveillance for all. Design decides.

quiz.question: What is the dual risk of digital identity programs?
options: They can include the undocumented but also enable surveillance
They are too expensive to implement
They only work in wealthy countries
